1.. COVID-19 UPDATE (CITY COUNCIL)  -  Action: adopted (Pass) Moved by Albert Robles Jawane Hilton entered the meeting during public comment. 

City Manager gave a presentation on the COVID-19 Trends

MPTJD inquired about if any city employees tested positive for COVID-19; Sharon Landers noted that the city is not aware of any employees at home or currently working testing positive.

Dani Cook gave a presentation on the COVID-19 Task Force

JD inquired about whether or not insurance companies will cover cost for retesting. Staff addressed his inquiry. 

Discussion ensued between City Council and City Manager regarding whether or not insurance companies cover the cost for retest and how US Health Fairs may assist with ensuring residents are not be charged more than once when the test results are not given and/or test are contaminated.  

City Manager Landers gave a presentation on the County's Roadmap to recover. 

JH inquired about the city's road to recovery plan. - staff noted that the Disaster Council will bring a plan back to City Council.

LDH inquired about Southbay Pavilion and malls opening. Staff will come back with more information.

MPTJD were in the stage will barbershop, beauty parlors and nail shops. it was clarified these types of uses are in Stage 3

CH inquired about when the parks will open. 

Discussion ensued between City Council regarding the city's road map to recovery and the reopening of parks.

AR noted the city can seek a variance and pursue a Carson path - AR moved to Direct staff to prepare a Carson Roadmap reopening retail, barber and hair salons with strict protocols for submission to the county to be brought back on June 2nd.  Seconded by CH

LDH inquired if city staff will be included. AR noted yes and addition to city parks. 

CH inquired about point of sale for surplus vehicles for enterprise rental car. Staff noted that taxes are received at the location of point of sale. 

LDH inquired about the graduation party that took place at Community Center and how does staff intend to address Queen Jones question. 

Staff noted they are investigating party gate and will speak with the Commissioner Jones re: interpretation of the states place of worship guidelines. She then inquired about the Furgent Technologies - ACM Roberts noted that is the laboratory

CH noted his COVID-19 test taken back in April was negative. He thanked all first responders

JH implored places of worship that intend to open to be prudent. In announced his newborn daughter is finally home after spending more than 40-days in the hospital. He also announced that Carson is a leading city in responding to the 2020 Census. 

MPTJD commended all first responders and noted the city's intent on moving forward with having a safe city.
